pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Assembly Events is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A packed conference stage under bold event lighting

children: We started Assembly Events because too many events are planned by one company and produced by another — and the seams always show. We do both, so they don’t.

From a 20-person leadership offsite to a 2,000-guest product launch, we bring the same thing: a sharp creative concept, ruthless logistics, and a producer who treats your budget and your reputation like their own.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We start with your goals — not a package — then shape a concept, a budget and a timeline you can actually stand behind.
We book and manage every partner, build the run-of-show, and keep a live budget so there are no surprises the week of.
A producer runs the room to the minute, handles the load-out, and delivers a wrap report — what worked, what it cost, what’s next.
